variants.title: NaI(Tl) efficiency at 511 keV (Na-22)
variants.unknown: the intrinsic photopeak efficiency of the crystal at 511 keV
variants.note: The 511 keV line is the annihilation photon: 1.806 per decay (two per positron, 90.3 % of decays).

source.title: NNDC / ENSDF: Na-22 511.0 keV, 180.6 % per decay (beta+ branch 90.3 %)

variants.title: NaI(Tl) efficiency at 59.5 keV (Am-241)
variants.unknown: the intrinsic photopeak efficiency of the crystal at 59.5 keV
variants.note: At 60 keV the crystal stops almost every photon that reaches it, so the intrinsic efficiency is close to the photofraction.

source.title: NNDC / ENSDF: Am-241 59.541 keV, 35.9 % per decay
